verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Sing praises unto God sing praises
Sing praises unto God sing praises
Hallelujah

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
For God is the king over all the earth
Sing praises unto him with understanding
So clap your hands and shout all ye people
For he is to be praised to be praised

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
For God is our king over all the earth
Sing praises unto him in understanding
So clap your hands and shout
All ye people for he is to be praised to be praised
